title: PonderThyOrb
description: A mod that adds an orb to ponder!
body:
Ponder is a mod which adds an orb which functions as a magic 8 ball, adding 6 unique outputs which allow you to attain answers from the beyond at will! Craftable with a glass block, two amethyst shards and one amethyst block, the orb has a low barrier of entry!

![An image of the orb on a table!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2033bea488308ff66dc89794c75279c5665ee757_0.webp)
